description: Dean receives a Strava post-run webhook for a 10-mile easy long run. Should acknowledge the run, give feedback on pace, and tie it to training progress.

user.name: Marcus
user.notes: First marathon. Wants to break 4 hours.

ground_truth.notes: Dean received a post_run webhook for a 10-mile long run at 9:10/mi. That pace is squarely in the easy zone (9:02 easy pace ± 20s). Response should: (1) acknowledge the 10-mile run, (2) affirm the pace was appropriate for an easy long run, (3) reference training context (week 8, building toward Chicago Marathon). Must NOT treat this as a non-run day, must NOT give incorrect mileage, must NOT confuse pace as too fast or too slow. Must NOT use additive mileage format like '22 mi planned + your 10 mi = 32 mi' — completed and planned miles must be stated separately.
